rows.grounds: locative plural of numeral as given

items.question: What kind of suffering befalls beings confined within the vast array of womb-diagrams?
premises: Beings exist within eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
Those womb-diagrams form a fixed field of confinement.
Confinement within those womb-diagrams entails torment for those beings.
items.inference: Beings in the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams are tormented by that mode of confinement.
uncertainties: The precise nature of the torment remains unspecified.
items.plain_english: In the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams, beings are tormented.
